source_and_parameter_lock: commit all formal source/config/protocol before first formal matrix; record entire per-file source SHA and Git commit
baseline_unchanged: same initial pose and uncertainty for all four arms
TRF dense exact analytic max50 nfev, tolerances1e-7

angular_model.integration: arrived left-hold, max100ms, no future endpoint or late backfill
angular_model.RW_covariance: joint angle/bias continuous RW, negative cross -q_b dt^2/2; Cholesky whitening
angular_model.missing: no angle factor, bias RW retained, held-yaw prediction only; no Odom angular fallback; publish and count invalid current edge
angular_model.rank: rank-aware square-root QR marginalization, retain semidefinite prior and affine offset; report missing rank, no invented diagonal constraint

generator.geometry: old frozen single-car anchors/P1/lever, new synthetic initial heading170deg for wrap; all arms identical
generator.initial_pose: true initial base = declared prior mean + independent N(0,[.10m,.10m,3deg]^2); Odom source pose starts[0,0,0], so no absolute room pose leaked; same input/prior across arms
generator.motion: stationary[0,4), forward[4,15), turn+lateral[15,25), reverse+lateral/opposite turn[25,32), forward/lateral/turn[32,42), stationary[42,51]
generator.clock: exact shared synthetic epoch plus identity header mapping; field identity mapping remains a declared unverified assumption unless B supplies accepted evidence
generator.odom_pose: integrate previous noisy/slipped twist independently of online factors; Odom.angular_z is that measured rate
generator.noise_limit: nominal sensor draws synthetic independent; real upstream dependence unknown. Drift/gap alter RNG consumption, so scenario-to-scenario noise not strictly paired; methods within a scenario share identical inputs
generator.gyro_drift: initial.010 + RW.0015(rad/s)/sqrt(s) + .015sin(t/8); deliberately different from estimator RW
generator.velocity_slip: noisy vx/vy*1.25 plus vy.05m/s [15,35)s; same contamination enters odom.pose
generator.imu_gap: no sources[18,22)s; source19s late arrival24s retained as explicit out-of-order negative
generator.stationary_unobservable: true motion0, XY lever0, gyro bias.025; noisy measured odom retains artificial weak excitation; exact-unobservable unit test uses exact-zero displacement

evaluation.all: every deadline retained; all-finite output errors include warmup, gaps and failed-solver predictions; finite pose coverage and solver/angle/valid coverage always reported
evaluation.common: four-arm intersection of estimate_valid at same state_epoch_ns, report count and errors alongside all-finite results; not the sole score
evaluation.truth: 5ms independently generated truth, offline-only interpolation for virtual compute-available timestamps; never passed to optimizer
evaluation.timing: separate exact source/header/receive/state/cutoff and virtual compute+queue available time; one-second wait retained
metrics: XY RMSE at virtual available time
oldest incident-factor marginalization information and offset
evaluation.readback: all input/output SHA, source identities, integral segments, prediction and objective costs; every13th marginalization independently finite-differenced without online factor imports

resume: only exact source/protocol and indexed input/output SHA match; no rerun of completed/failed cells; retain unindexed partial evidence
